prompt: An Apache virtual host was configured for `www.example.com` and `www2.example.com` using `<VirtualHost *:80>` with two `ServerName` lines (`ServerName www.example.com` and `ServerName www2.example.com`). The file is processed without error, but requests to both names are not handled correctly. What should be changed?
choices: The configuration must be split into two `<VirtualHost>` sections since each may only have one name
Only one `ServerName` declaration may exist, but additional names can be declared with `ServerAlias`
The port in the opening `<VirtualHost>` tag must be appended to the `ServerName` values
Both names must be placed as comma-separated values in one `ServerName` declaration
Both names must be listed in the opening `<VirtualHost>` tag
explanation: A virtual host may have only one `ServerName`; additional hostnames are declared with the `ServerAlias` directive.
